name: Feeding America
description: The nation’s largest hunger-relief organization, supporting a network of food banks across the United States.
address: 35 East Wacker Drive, Suite 2000, Chicago, IL 60601
hours: Contact for local food bank referral
eligibility: Services are delivered through local member food banks; eligibility varies by location.

name: The Salvation Army USA
description: Nationwide social-service network providing food, shelter, disaster response, utility help, and emergency assistance.
eligibility: Local programs set their own eligibility and intake requirements.
source: The Salvation Army USA official website

name: Catholic Charities USA
description: National network of local agencies offering housing, food, immigration, disaster, and family support.
eligibility: Programs and eligibility vary by local Catholic Charities agency.

name: United Way Worldwide
description: Global network connecting people with local help for housing, food, health, education, and financial stability.
eligibility: Local 211 operators connect callers with available community resources.

name: American Red Cross
description: Disaster relief, emergency preparedness, blood services, military family support, and lifesaving training.
eligibility: Disaster assistance depends on the incident and local response capacity.

name: Goodwill Industries International
description: Network of local organizations providing job training, employment services, and donated goods programs.
eligibility: Local Goodwill organizations determine program eligibility.

name: YMCA of the USA
description: Nationwide network supporting youth development, healthy living, childcare, housing, and community programs.
eligibility: Local YMCA branches set program eligibility and fees.
source: YMCA of the USA official website

name: NAMI
description: National mental health organization offering education, support groups, advocacy, and local affiliate referrals.
hours: Contact local affiliate for support options
eligibility: Many education and support resources are free; local programs vary.

name: The National Domestic Violence Hotline
description: Confidential crisis support, safety planning, information, and referrals for people affected by domestic violence.
eligibility: Confidential support is available regardless of documentation or income.

name: Habitat for Humanity International
description: Global housing organization working with families and communities to build and improve affordable homes.
eligibility: Local affiliates determine application requirements and service areas.
source: Habitat for Humanity International official website
